topics.title: Meaning and Types of Safety Primary 5 (Basic 5) - Security Education
topics.content:
SECURITY EDUCATION
RELIGION AND NATIONAL VALUES
FIRST TERM
WEEK 5
PRIMARY 5
THEME - ELEMENTS OF SECURITY
PREVIOUS LESSON -
TOPIC - SAFETY
LEARNING AREA
1. Introductory Activities
2. Meaning of Safety
3. Types of Safety
4. Lesson Evaluation and Weekly Assessment (Test)
PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES
By the end of the lesson, most of the pupils should have attained the following objectives -
1. explain the meaning of safety.
2. state and explain the types of safety.
ENTRY BEHAVIOUR
The pupils can identify some of the safety tools.
INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS
The teacher will teach the lesson with the aid of chart showing chart showing safety tools.
METHOD OF TEACHING
Choose a suitable and appropriate methods for the lessons.
Note - Irrespective of choosing methods of teaching, always introduce an activities that will arouse pupil’s interest or lead them to the lessons.
REFERENCE MATERIALS
1. Scheme of Work
2. 9 - Years Basic Education Curriculum
3. Course Book
4. All Relevant Material
5. Online Information
CONTENT OF THE LESSON
LESSON 1 - INTRODUCTION
MEANING OF SAFETY
Safety is the protection from harm, dangers and to understand dangers.
There are three (3) of safety,
- Normative safety
- Substantive safety
- Perceived safety
TYPES OF SAFETY
1. NORMATIVE SAFETY
Normative safety is the safety that meets the safety standards and practices.
2. SUBSTANTIVE SAFETY
Substantive safety is the safety that has the real - world history is favorable weather or not standards are met.
3. PERCEIVED SAFETY
Perceived safety is the level of safety feel by the users.
LESSON 2 - REVISION AND WEEKLY ASSESSMENT
PRESENTATION
To deliver the lesson, the teacher adopts the following steps:
1. Revises the previous lesson based the pupil’s related knowledge or  understanding.
2. Leads a discussion on the concept of security and types.
Pupil’s Activities - Participate actively in the class discussion.
3. Summarizes each lesson on the board.
Pupil’s Activities - Copy as instructed.
CONCLUSION
To conclude the lesson for the week, the teacher revises the entire lesson and links it to the following week’s lesson.
NEXT LESSON
LESSON EVALUATION
Ask pupils to:
1. explain the meaning of safety.
2. state 3 types of safety.
3. explain each of safety mentioned in question 2.
